rows.en: ＊Narusawa＊＠００１＿０１０Your answer...＝＠００１＿０１１Heh. No need to ask, is there?￥...I'm counting on you.
＊Natsuno＊＠０６８＿００８Don't worry. You've got me,￥remember? Whatever happens,￥I'll protect you!
＊Narusawa＊＠００１＿０１２That settles it. The two￥qualified candidates for Project￥Elan have been chosen.
＊Narusawa＊＠００１＿０１３The two who qualified now begin￥a month of final preparations.＝＠００１＿０１４Everyone else, your job is to￥support them.＝＠００１＿０１５And one more thing...
＊Narusawa＊＠００１＿０１６Tonight we celebrate early.￥Forget rank. Let loose!
－　One Month Later　－＝－　； and Natsuno Depart　－

＊Natsuno＊＠０６８＿００９When I first came here, I was￥convinced going to Elan was￥my only option...＝＠０６８＿０１０But now I feel like I chose this￥path myself, out of so many￥possibilities.＝＠０６８＿０１１And with you, who gave me the￥push to change like that...＝＠０６８＿０１２I'm sure it'll all work out.＝＠０６８＿０１４Whatever hardships come, the two￥of us can overcome them!
